summary: Troubleshooting steps for WinRM: test connections from another Windows host with winrs or Invoke-Command over HTTP/HTTPS, check DNS with dig or ping, and check ports 5985/5986 with nc.
questions: How do I tell if my WinRM problem is Ansible or the Windows host?
How do I test a WinRM connection from another Windows machine?
How can I check that port 5986 is open on a Windows host?
How do I test PSRP over HTTPS while ignoring certificate errors?

answer_card.title: Troubleshooting WinRM connectivity
answer_card.answer_md:
From another Windows host:

```powershell
winrs -r:http://server:5985/wsman -u:Username -p:Password ipconfig
winrs -r:https://server:5986/wsman -u:Username -p:Password -ssl ipconfig
Invoke-Command -UseSSL -ComputerName server { ipconfig } -Credential username
# skip cert checks
$o = New-PSSessionOption -SkipCACheck -SkipCNCheck -SkipRevocationCheck
```

From the control node: `dig +search server` (or `ping`) for DNS, and `nc -zv server 5985` / `nc -zv server 5986` to check the listener and firewall.
